correctness.rationale: All edge subsets in the four 3n-edge graphs enumerated; two complete acyclic Hasse matchings per graph (936, 7976, 64040, 493212 covers), integer Morse matrices [[1,0],[0,1],[-1,1]] and [[-1],[1],[-1],[1]] give unimodular cancellations, and independent full mod-two boundary reductions confirm Betti ranks (1,1,1,3) in dimensions (3,5,7,8). All sphere-wedge conclusions follow from positive-dimensional attaching degree classifications.
